When he spotted Tyler in his car, he brought the performance right up to the window Tyler couldn’t stop laughing during their exchange before eventually driving off.

source_caption_text:
Never forget when Tyler drove away from Diddy on Halloween when he was dressed like Joker 😂😭

Back in 2022, Diddy dressed as Heath Ledger’s character from “The Dark Knight,” complete with the purple coat, green vest and face paint. When he spotted Tyler in his car, he brought the performance right up to the window 💀

Tyler couldn’t stop laughing during their exchange before eventually driving off. The costume was convincing, but trying to keep a straight face with Tyler there was a whole different challenge 😭

Who remembers this clip? 👀👇

🎥 via Diddy / Halloween 2022
